response:
Three bug found.

BUG 1: group_transactions sort backward.
Docstring say oldest first. Code use reverse=True. Newest first. Balance wrong too - apply newest tx first, then older.
FIX: change reverse=True to reverse=False, or drop reverse arg.
  txs.sort(key=lambda t: t["timestamp"])

BUG 2: average_daily_balance lose balance on day no tx.
Code set balances_by_day[day] = balance_after. If no tx on day, get 0. Wrong! Real balance = last known balance from prior day. Also if many tx same day, only last one kept - okay if history sorted oldest-first (bug 1 fix needed).
FIX: carry forward last balance. Walk days in order, track running balance.

  last_balance = 0
  # find balance at start_day: last balance before start_day
  sorted_entries = sorted(history, key=lambda e: e["tx"]["timestamp"])
  day_to_last_balance = {}
  for entry in sorted_entries:
      day = entry["tx"]["timestamp"] // day_seconds
      day_to_last_balance[day] = entry["balance_after"]

  # seed with balance before start_day
  running = 0
  for entry in sorted_entries:
      day = entry["tx"]["timestamp"] // day_seconds
      if day < start_day:
          running = entry["balance_after"]
      else:
          break

  total = 0
  for day in range(start_day, end_day):
      if day in day_to_last_balance:
          running = day_to_last_balance[day]
      total += running
  return total / (end_day - start_day)

BUG 3: top_accounts_by_activity sort wrong way.
Say top-N. Code sort ascending, take first N. Get bottom-N!
FIX: add reverse=True.
  return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)[:top_n]

Also bug 2 has divide-by-zero risk if end_day == start_day. Guard it.
Also bug 2: no guard for end_day < start_day.
